title: Hypergraph Ramsey Numbers via Oriented Palette Constructions
problem: Lower bound 2^{Omega(n log n)} on r_k(B^(k),n), matching the Mubayi-Suk upper bound, plus r_k(k+1,t;n) and fixed-cycle families.
method: Oriented palette labelling of lower-dimensional faces excludes red configurations, and a hypergraph container argument bounds blue cliques.

title: Ramsey numbers of fixed-length cycles, paths and stars in set-colored triple systems
problem: Asymptotic Ramsey numbers gamma n + o(n) for linear paths and cycles, and bounds for stars, in set-colored triple systems.
method: Parity choice for the connecting paths, with varying path lengths, to hit exactly n edges in a linear cycle.

title: On the Kissing Number of Craig's Lattice and Spherical List Decoding
problem: Shows the Bacher lower bound on the kissing number of Craig lattices A_{p-1}^k is asymptotically tight, and computes kissing numbers up to dimension 521.
method: Polynomial-time list decoder for spherical codes from Craig lattices, plus an efficient algorithm that counts shortest vectors.

title: Ramsey Numbers of Most Even-Linked Double Stars
problem: Exact r(S_{2p}(n,m)) = max(2n+2p-1, n+2m+3p-1) for m >= p-2 >= 0.
method: Upper bound through the existence or nonexistence of a polarized pair, with a matching lower bound by construction.

title: Ramsey numbers of loose triangles versus cliques
problem: Proves R(C_3, K_t^(r)) = O_r(t^{3/2}/sqrt(log log t)), confirming the Kostochka-Mubayi-Verstraete o(t^{3/2}) conjecture.

title: Set-coloring Ramsey numbers with multiple intersections
problem: Shadow inequality R(G;r,s,t) <= R(G;C(r,t),C(s,t),1) and asymptotic bounds for trees, paths, cycles and cliques with a piecewise-linear threshold function Phi_n.
method: Reduction to ordinary set-coloring Ramsey numbers through the shadow inequality, with transfer of known clique bounds.

title: Zero-sum Ramsey numbers of forests, cycles and complete bipartite graphs
problem: Disproves the Bialostocki-Dierker asymptotic conjecture for forests and gives exact R(mK_{q,q}, Z_m) and R(C_l, Z_m) for large l.
method: Caro's transfer inequality combined with a spanning result for the packing upper bound.

title: Idiosynchromatic Poetry
problem: Exact values of r(omega^2 2, 3), r(kappa lambda 2, 3) and r(kappa lambda 3, 3) for infinite cardinal Ramsey numbers.
method: Equivalence between asymmetric partition relations on weakly compact cardinals and finitary edge-coloured digraph problems.

title: An extremal unimodular lattice of rank 37
problem: Constructs an extremal unimodular lattice of rank 37 with kissing number 35,594 and settles the rank-37 coding case.
method: Cayley-table incidence lattice from Z/13Z with norm-4 vectors, plus an exhaustive count of unimodular completions.

title: Latin cubes of order 4 and 4320-point quaternionic constructions in R^16
problem: Gives a family of 4320-point kissing arrangements in R^16 and counts 4,072,728,621 isometry classes in it.
method: Quaternionic construction parameterized by three Latin cubes of order 4 and six permutations, with computer-aided counting.

title: On edge-ordered Ramsey numbers of hypergraphs
problem: Bound R_edge(F^<;q) <= R_h(F;q)^{C m^2}, with no tower-height increase, settling a problem of Fox and Li.
method: Reduction from the edge-ordered number to the unordered Ramsey number, with an exponent polynomial in the edge count m.

title: The asymptotics of off-diagonal book Ramsey numbers
problem: r(B_{ceil(alpha n)}, B_n) = (c(alpha)+o(1)) n for every fixed alpha, determining when the random lower bound is tight.
method: Defect-compensation framework built around a K4-free auxiliary graph for the upper bounds.

title: New upper bounds for average kissing numbers
problem: Improves upper bounds on average kissing numbers in dimensions 3 to 30 and shows the averages equal 240 and 196560 in dimensions 8 and 24.
method: Semidefinite programming bound on the average contact number of finite ball packings.

title: An upper bound of 60 for the Ramsey number R(3,3,3,3)
problem: R(3,3,3,3) <= 60, improved from 62.
method: Global incidence count, classification of small neighbourhoods, and exhaustive SAT with two solvers; reductions formalized in Lean.
checked: partial (Lean formalization of the reductions; each resulting formula refuted by two SAT solvers, per abstract)

title: Constructions for Nearly Diagonal Book Ramsey Numbers
problem: Infinite new families of n with R(B_{n-1}, B_n) = 4n-1.
method: Design-theoretic constructions; some results were found with the Station multi-agent system (per abstract).

title: New lower bounds for kissing numbers in dimensions 32-35 and 37-39
problem: Lower bounds 352320, 370240, 390980, 415308, 499816, 605322 and 768916 for kissing numbers in dimensions 32 to 39 except 36.
method: Local search for binary constant-weight codes added to Edel-Rains-Sloane configurations, with pairwise checks in exact integer arithmetic.
checked: partial (all pairs checked in exact integer arithmetic, per abstract)

title: A Computer-Assisted Proof that R(5,10;5,8)=21 for the Generalized Threshold Ramsey Number
problem: R(5,10;5,8) = 21, with 17 extremal graphs at order 20 and a tabulation of r_5(m,n) for m,n up to 10.
method: Enumeration of good graphs, a lucky-vertex inequality filter, and SAT encodings of gluing cases.
checked: partial (computer-assisted; verifier not stated in abstract)

title: Multicolor Ramsey numbers of unbalanced double stars
problem: r(S(n,m);k) = kn+m+2 for k >= 5 under a stated condition, and r(S(n,m);4) = 4n+m+1 for odd n >= 15m.
method: New edge-colouring construction for the lower bound, with the matching upper bound from Ruotolo and Song.

title: New bounds for off-diagonal hypergraph Ramsey numbers
problem: Proves the Conlon et al. polynomial-growth conjecture for 3-graphs with at most five tight components, and gives quasipolynomial bounds for forward-doubleable 3-graphs such as the Fano plane.

title: Lattices with Large Kissing Number from Local Density
problem: kappa_p(n) >= 2^{Omega(sqrt n)} for all p >= 1, and kappa_2(n) improves the previous 2^{Theta(log^2 n)} bound.
method: Equivalence between lattices with large kissing number and exact locally dense lattices, instantiated by Craig lattices, sparsified Z^n and rotated checkerboard lattices.

title: Tight Query Lower Bounds for Quantum Sampling, with an Application to Certified Randomness
problem: Exceeding the ideal XEB score by a constant needs Omega(N^{1/3}) queries, and the output has n - O(log n) bits of smooth min-entropy.
method: Progress measures that grow slightly per query: polynomial method plus compressed oracle for Fourier sampling, and Dirichlet-polynomial level expansion for Haar states.

title: Quantum Query Complexity and Span Programs from Pre-Geometry
problem: Certified interval 3.9087553 < Adv(f_R) < 3.9301 for the pointed R10 closure, and Q(F) = Theta(N^alpha) for 0.6204277 < alpha < 0.6229063.
method: Matroid organization of the span program optimum, with exact 1-, 2- and 3-sum reductions along a Seymour decomposition.

title: Upper bounds for ordered Ramsey numbers of forests and bounded-degree graphs
problem: R_<(F,F) = O(n^{1+ceil(log chi_<(F))}) for ordered forests, and R_<(H,K_n) = O(n^{f(Delta,k)}) for bounded-degree ordered graphs.

title: Large-Scale Autonomous Discovery of Kissing Number Constructions
problem: New lower bounds in dimensions 25, 27, 32-39, 43, 45 and 49-55, for example K(25) >= 197580 and K(55) >= 53301140.
method: Autonomous multi-agent search producing signed-code replacements, cross-shell lattice constructions and spherical-design moment certificates, each reduced to a finite certificate.

title: Optimization hierarchies for extremal geometry through complete positivity
problem: Converging semidefinite hierarchies for spherical codes, distance-avoiding sets and sphere-packing density, with bounds for Witsenhausen's problem.
method: Hierarchies of completely positive functions with the Lovasz theta number and a moment hierarchy.

title: Sharper Zarankiewicz and Diagonal Bipartite Ramsey Bounds
problem: b(t,t) = O(2^t), improving O(2^t log t); the abstract says the proof was found by an AI model.

title: Optimally pseudorandom K4-free graphs
problem: Explicit K4-free graphs of degree Theta(n^{4/5}) and r(4,t) >= t^{1.666...-o(1)}.
method: Construction inside the split Cayley hexagon that matches Alon's 1994 upper bound.

title: A General Upper Bound on Multicolor Ordered Ramsey Numbers
problem: r_<(G;q) in n^{O(d^{q-1} ceil(log chi)^{q-1})}, polynomial in n for fixed parameters.
method: Degeneracy and interval-chromatic-number bound that extends Conlon, Fox, Lee and Sudakov.

title: New lower bounds for kissing numbers in dimensions 25-31
problem: New lower bounds tau_25 >= 197058 through tau_31 >= 238354.
method: Rotation of the lifted block in the Leech lifting from dimension 24, with a nonorthogonal diagonal deformation for dimension 25.

title: Towards Block-Level Fault-Tolerant Quantum Simulation on Small High-Rate Non-CSS Codes
problem: Circuit-level memory pseudo-threshold near 1.5e-3 for the [[8,3,3]] code, and a protected limit that restores pseudo-threshold behaviour after removing identified malignant first-order locations.
method: Single-fault analysis that traces a fault on the shared parity ancilla through the uncomputation network to an undetectable logical operator.

title: A lattice family with kissing numbers tau(L_n) >= e^{2 sqrt n}
problem: Lattices L_q in Z^q with kissing number at least (1/(2 pi e^2)+o(1)) sqrt(q) e^{2 sqrt q}.
method: Extension of the Bennett-Peikert Reed-Solomon construction.

title: Multicolor Ramsey numbers of ordered matchings
problem: For almost every perfect matching M on [n], r_<(M;q) > 2^{c_q (log n)^q/(log log n)^{q-1}}.
method: Probabilistic construction over random perfect matchings (per abstract; details not stated).

title: Induced Size-Ramsey Numbers of Odd Cycles via Spread Measures
problem: R_ind(C_n;k) = e^{Theta(k)} n for odd n, resolving the Bradac-Draganic-Sudakov conjecture.
method: Spread probability weights on candidate cycles with a quadratic chord score, combined with random sparsification and hypergraph containers.

title: Quantum Query Algorithms for the Constructive Diagonal Ramsey Theorem
field: constructive Ramsey theory, quantum query complexity
problem: Homogeneous K-sets in O(2^K K log(K/eta)) edge queries, and an Omega(N^{1/12}) quantum lower bound.
method: Constructive recursion over implicit candidate sets, sampled by capped unknown-solution quantum search with a scale-aware concentration schedule.

title: Ramsey properties of maximal (outer)planar graphs
problem: Complete list of unavoidable pairs for maximal outerplanar graphs and, for the diagonal case, for maximal planar graphs (P3, P4, P5, K13, S_{2,1,1}).

title: The Multicolour Size-Ramsey Number of an Even Cycle
problem: R_k(C_n) = Theta(k^2 log k) n for even n >= 100 log k.
method: Upper-bound construction that improves Javadi, Kohayakawa and Miralaei (unclear beyond that from abstract).

title: Asymptotic Bounds for Online Ramsey Numbers of Stars versus Long Paths and Cycles
problem: Upper bound improved from (k+o(1))n to ((k+3)/3+o(1))n for stars versus long paths and cycles.

title: New lower bounds for constant-weight codes via seeded bit-swap tabu search
problem: 124 new lower bounds on A(n,d,w), with improved kissing lower bounds tau_32, tau_33, tau_34 and tau_37.
method: Seeded initialization followed by bit-swap tabu search.

title: Tripartite Zarankiewicz numbers and norm graphs
problem: ex(n,n,n,K_{3,3}) = (3/2^{1/3} + o(1)) n^{5/3}, and the asymptotic tripartite multicolour Ramsey number of K_{3,3}.
method: Quotient norm graphs of Alon, Ronyai and Szabo for the lower bound, with a Tait-Timmons-type upper bound.

title: Learning Nearest-Neighbor Maps from Adaptive Queries
problem: Tight Theta(n kappa) query complexity for hidden-set recovery, where kappa is the kissing number of the norm, and O(min(n,d)) queries on the sphere.
method: Randomized dimension reduction that lowers the query count from O(nd) to O(min(n,d)).

title: Ramsey Multiplicity for Ordered Graphs
problem: Lower bounds on ordered star and perfect-matching multiplicities, and upper bounds by construction.
method: Amplification inequality that lifts a t-vertex multiplicity bound to n vertices.

title: Optimal Extensions of Cross-Sections: Sphere Packings in Dimensions 38 to 43
problem: Improved sphere packings in dimensions 38 to 43, and improved kissing numbers, including dimension 45.
method: Chain of determinant-minimal cross-section extensions of the extremal lattice P_{48p}, plus an antipode packing for dimension 43.

title: Multicolor vector space Ramsey numbers over the binary field
problem: Tower bound of height independent of k for R_2(t;k), via reduction to classical hypergraph Ramsey numbers.
method: Binary simplex codes reduce vector-space colourings to hypergraph Ramsey numbers.

title: Entanglement Quantification via Symmetric Extensions: A Resource Theory Hierarchy
problem: Hierarchy E_k of faithful, convex, monotone measures that detects bound entanglement at k = 2 (abstract claim); numerical tests on Werner states.
method: Minimal eigenvalue shift over k-symmetric PPT extensions, computed by semidefinite programming.

title: Bootstrapping Euclidean Lattices
problem: Bound on the mean square count of nearest minimal vectors divided by the kissing number, saturated in dimensions 2, 4, 8 and 24.
method: Semidefinite programming bootstrap with exact functionals for spectral identities on flat tori.

title: Harnessing the Collective Intelligence of AI Agents in the Wild for New Discoveries
problem: Kissing lower bound in dimension 11 raised from 593 to 604, reported as one of 12 new results as of May 2026.
method: Open distributed submissions, verifier refinement and agent-to-agent reuse of ideas.

title: An automated proof that R(B_8,B_10)=37
method: AI-assisted search, with a Lean formalization of the upper-bound argument.
checked: partial (Lean formalization of the upper-bound argument, per abstract)

title: Off-diagonal Ramsey numbers
problem: r(s,k) >= Omega(k^{s-1}/(log k)^{2s-4}) for fixed s >= 3, matching Erdos-Szekeres up to polylogarithmic factors.

title: Prime Certificates for Exact Vertex-Coprime Ramsey Numbers
problem: Exact R_cop(k_1,...,k_c) = p_{sum(k_i-1)}, and an exact edge-colouring variant reduced to classical Ramsey numbers.
method: Prime clique gives the upper bound by pigeonhole, and a prime-bin partition gives the lower bound.

title: Book Ramsey numbers via algebraic constructions
problem: R(B_n,B_n) = 4n+1 for infinitely many n.
method: Graphs built from pseudo-cyclic strongly regular graphs.

title: Computation of small reflective and dihedral Ramsey numbers
problem: Lower bounds for small reflective and dihedral Ramsey numbers for several graph classes.
method: Computer search for Gamma-embeddable colourings (method details beyond this are not in the abstract).

title: Ramsey-type results for threshold graphs and beyond
problem: Exponential upper and lower bounds on the induced threshold-graph Ramsey function r'_2(s).

title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
problem: Results on 5 of 12 AlphaEvolve construction problems, including a 604-point kissing configuration in dimension 11 and new infinite families for book Ramsey numbers.
method: Multi-agent Station environment; results supported by exact constructions or Lean-verified proofs.

title: Nonexistence of strongly regular graphs via multipoint spherical semidefinite bounds
problem: Excludes strongly regular graphs with parameters (351,140,73,44), (550,162,75,36), (703,182,81,35) and (1344,221,88,26); no parameter set with 45 vertices.
method: Multipoint spherical semidefinite bounds, with dual solutions checked in exact rational arithmetic.
checked: partial (dual solutions verified in exact rational arithmetic, per abstract)

title: Nonexistence of Strongly Regular Graphs via Gegenbauer Positivity and SRG Counting
method: Extends the Liao-Yu multipoint method with Gegenbauer kernels and SRG counting identities.

title: Bipartite cuts in Ramsey-Turan style
problem: K5-free graphs with sublinear independence number can be made bipartite by removing n^2(1/18+o(1)) edges, and 1/18 is best possible.
method: Edge-weighted Turan-type extension with a flag-algebra computation.

title: A short proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture via the completion framework
problem: Deterministic algorithm with O(Q(f)^6/(eps delta)^2) queries on a delta fraction of inputs (a proof of the AA conjecture, as claimed).
method: Completion framework, giving a more general bound.

title: Quantum Query Complexity of Persistence Statistics in Graph Zigzags
problem: Query complexity of estimating zigzag bar-lifetime statistics from snapshot adjacency bits.

title: Quantum lower bounds for convex optimization and real matrix-vector query problems
problem: Quantum query complexity of convex minimization is Omega~(n), nearly matching the upper bound.
method: unclear from abstract (the abstract credits AI systems in the work)

title: Fast Quantum Algorithms for Learning Linear Threshold Functions
problem: Three results on fast quantum algorithms for learning linear threshold functions.

title: Optimal Quantum-Classical Separations for Exact Learning
problem: Relations among deterministic, randomized and quantum membership-query complexities of concept classes.

title: Optimal Quantum Junta Testing
problem: Tight quantum query complexity of k-junta testing for Boolean functions, unitaries and channels.

title: Distributional Quantum Query Complexity
problem: Distributional versions of composition and direct-product properties for quantum query complexity.

title: Tight bounds for hybrid quantum-classical query algorithms
problem: Matching bounds for phase estimation (Theta(1/(q eps^2))) and amplitude estimation in the hybrid model.

title: Quantum Query Complexity Beyond the Worst Case
problem: A total function whose smoothed quantum query complexity is exponentially smaller than its classical query complexity.
method: Smoothed analysis applied to quantum query complexity.

title: Strong Selective and List-Decoding Direct Product Theorems for Quantum Query Complexity
problem: Strong direct-product theorems for relations, including selective and list-decoding versions.
method: Extension of the multiplicative adversary method to relations.

title: A General Composition Theorem for Approximate Degree
problem: Matching lower bound for multiplicative composition of approximate degree for all total Boolean functions.
method: Lower bound that matches Sherstov's upper bound (technique not detailed in abstract).

title: Quantum Query Complexity for List Search
problem: Theta(min{ell, (N ell)^{1/4}}) quantum query complexity for linked-list search, below the classical Theta(ell) when N < ell^3.

title: Noisy Quantum Query Complexity via Fractional Block Sensitivity
problem: Lower bounds under negligent oracles in terms of fractional block sensitivity fbs(f,0^n).
method: Fractional block sensitivity lower-bound framework applied to several imperfect-oracle models.

title: A Noise Operator Approach to Quantum Query Complexity and Time-Space Tradeoff Lower Bounds
problem: Time-bounded quantum query algorithms have exponentially small success probability, and strong time-space tradeoffs.
method: Noise operator stability bound, applied through classical arguments.

title: Near-Optimal Separations of Certificate Complexity from Randomized and Quantum Query Complexity
problem: Total Boolean function with R_1(f) = Theta(sqrt(C(f))), optimal even with two-sided error.

title: Superlinear Quantum Query Lower Bounds for Subgraph Detection
problem: First unconditional superlinear bounded-error quantum query lower bound for subgraph detection.
method: unclear from abstract (the abstract notes that the nonnegative-weight adversary method cannot give a superlinear bound)

title: Improved Quantum Query Bounds for Boolean Matrix Product Verification
problem: Upper bound O~(n^{17/12}) for Boolean matrix product verification, improving the O(n^{3/2}) Grover-based bound.

title: The quantum query complexity of the semigroup product problem
problem: Query bounds for semigroup products that depend on the product breadth beta of the semigroup.
method: Product breadth parameter that captures algebraic structure.

title: Quantum Submodular Maximization
problem: Unconstrained (1/2 - eps)-approximation with O_eps(log n) queries in the exact reversible value-oracle model.

title: Optimal transducers using symmetries
problem: Optimal transducers for quantum algorithms, using symmetries of the dual adversary semidefinite program.
method: Symmetry reduction of the dual adversary SDP feasible points.

title: Near-optimal quantum query lower bounds on bipartiteness and expansion testing in the bounded-degree model
problem: Near-optimal quantum query lower bounds for bipartiteness and expansion testing.

title: Randomized query complexity can beat certificate complexity
problem: Total function with R(f) = O~(sqrt(C(f))) and Q(f) = O~(C(f)^{1/4}), resolving a long-standing question.
method: Explicit construction (technique not detailed in abstract).

title: Quantum Query Advantage Requires Space
problem: Explicit total Boolean function with Q = O~(M) and R = Theta(M^{21/20}).

title: Quantum Query Complexity of Finding a Tarski Fixed Point on a High-Dimensional Grid
problem: Quantum query complexity of Tarski fixed-point search on high-dimensional grids.

title: Fault-tolerant quantum computation cannot be achieved with constant spacetime overhead
problem: Shows that preserving a logical qubit cannot be done with constant spacetime overhead, for a threshold-theorem setting.

title: Provably Efficient Self-Calibrating Quantum Fault Tolerance
problem: Keeps physical operations below the fault-tolerance threshold while analog control parameters drift.
method: Self-calibration of drifting control parameters (method details not in abstract).

title: Fault-Tolerant Logical Operations and Efficient State Preparation in Modular Quantum Architectures
problem: Effect of module-interface and in-QPU errors on fault-tolerant computation.

title: A solution to 2-copy distillability of Werner states
problem: Werner states in arbitrary dimension are 2-copy distillable if and only if they are 1-copy distillable (claimed solution of a longstanding open question).

title: Two-copy nondistillability of Werner states: sharp partial-trace inequalities and finite-copy extensions
problem: Werner state rho_alpha is 2-copy distillable iff alpha < -1/2; rho^(4)_{-1/2} is 2-copy undistillable; for each k there is gamma_k > 0 (not explicit) with k-copy undistillability for alpha >= -gamma_k.
method: Sharp Hilbert-Schmidt inequality for partial traces of rank-at-most-two operators, extended to finitely many copies.

title: On the two-copy distillability of Werner states and a new partial trace inequality
problem: Answers Problem 5 of the PRX Quantum open-problems list negatively: rho(4,-1/2) is not 2-copy distillable, and rho(d,alpha) is 2-copy undistillable for all d >= 2 iff alpha >= -1/2.
method: Frobenius-norm partial-trace inequality for matrices of rank at most r.

title: A partial-trace matrix inequality and Werner-state distillability
problem: Two-copy undistillability of NPT Werner states in arbitrary local dimension.
method: Partial-trace inequality for every matrix of rank at most two.

title: On the saturated cases of the distillability conjecture
problem: Characterizes the equality cases of the conjectured two-copy inequality for 4x4 Werner states; equality forces A and B to be 2x2 block-diagonal.
method: Saturation analysis of the conjectured inequality.

title: Entanglement of purification for Werner states: canonical purification and nonadditivity
problem: Claims the von Neumann entanglement of purification is nonadditive, and gives the exact value for two-qubit Werner states with singlet weight 1/64 <= f <= 1/4.
method: Comparison of canonical purification (reflected entropy) with the regularized entanglement of purification.

title: The entanglement of purification is not additive
problem: Claims the entanglement of purification is not additive on tensor powers, an open question since 2002.

title: Two-qutrit Werner state is always local
problem: Two-qutrit Werner states admit a local hidden-variable model for all parameter values with two measurements and three outcomes.
method: Sufficient condition under which a two-qutrit state satisfies the CGLMP inequality.

title: Multinegativity and single-letter formulas for asymptotic entanglement
problem: Decreasing hierarchy of computable upper bounds on the asymptotic relative entropy of entanglement.
method: Multinegativity hierarchy built from partial transposes of several copies.

title: On PPT entanglement distillation
problem: Regularized formula for PPT distillable entanglement and two single-letter converse bounds.

title: On the separability of Bell-diagonal states with absolutely positive partial transposition
problem: Whether APPT and absolutely separable states coincide beyond qubit-qudit systems, for a structured family of Bell-diagonal states.
method: Spectral constraints from APPT conditions on Bell-diagonal states.

title: Spectral bounds for the partial transpose
problem: Finer structure of the negative spectrum of the partial transpose, via a hierarchy of bounds.
method: Hierarchical bounds on the negative eigenvalues of the partial transpose (details beyond the abstract not visible).

title: Tight Bounds for Purity and Product Testing from Partial Transposition
problem: Tight sample bounds for purity and product testing using partial-transposition measurements.
method: Partial transposition as a measurement that controls adaptivity across copies.

title: The inverse eigenvalue problem for Partial Transposes of Two-Qubit States and Sharp Entanglement Bounds
problem: Sharp bounds on negativity from low-order partial-transpose moments for two-qubit states.
method: Solving the inverse eigenvalue problem for partial transposes of two-qubit states.

title: Geometric Characterization and Feasible Region Analysis of Bipartite Qutrit Bound Entanglement
problem: Closed-form quadratic boundary of the PPT-leaf region in a three-parameter qutrit family.
method: PPT criterion combined with a non-completely-positive map, giving a geometric partition of the state simplex.

title: Spectral Optimization for Absolutely PPT States: Purity, Entropy, and Volume Decay
problem: Maximum purity and minimum entropy of APPT states, with an explicit bound for every mn >= 6.
method: Outer spectral polytope from Hildebrand's criterion, with classified vertices.

title: PPT Entanglement with Correlated Catalysis: Monotones and Irreversibility
problem: Which transformation limits remain under freely available correlated catalysts in the PPT framework.
method: Monotone analysis for PPT operations with correlated catalysts (details beyond the abstract not visible).

title: Asymptotic Entanglement Hiding under Stabilizer Restrictions
problem: Hiding of entanglement under stabilizer restrictions vanishes uniformly over entangled Werner states as local dimension grows through odd primes.
method: Stabilizer-restricted local operations analysed on Werner states.

title: Lower Bound for Region of Non-Distillable Magic States
problem: Lower bound on the region of non-distillable magic states outside the stabilizer octahedron.
method: Expansion of the Campbell and Browne bound-magic-state argument.

title: The resource cost of magic in a code block
problem: Bounds the magic of a post-selected logical measurement by the resource that produced it.
method: Outcome-by-outcome witness that tests the accepted effect against the free set of the magic resource theory.

title: Distributed Resource Theory of Entanglement and Magic
problem: Unified resource theory of entanglement and magic for distributed fault-tolerant computation (DREAM).
method: Joint resource-theoretic framework for the two currencies (details beyond the abstract not visible).

title: Non-local Magic: closed-form solution and equivalence with magic of purification
problem: Closed-form non-local magic for the log-stabilizer fidelity, depending only on the Schmidt spectrum, and equivalence with the magic of purification.
method: Analytic optimization over local unitaries for the log-stabilizer fidelity.

title: Causal inequalities witness non-stabilizerness
problem: Causal inequalities certify non-stabilizerness in the operational resource theory of magic.

title: Catalytic Activation of Genuine Multipartite Entanglement and Nonlocality
problem: Any biseparable state that is not partition separable can be deterministically transformed into a GME state with a catalyst and LOCC.
method: Catalytic deterministic transformation using local operations.

title: Exact Catalysis Cannot Overcome the Gaussian-Steering Barrier for Remote Wigner Negativity
problem: Catalysts cannot lift the Gaussian-steering requirement for remote Wigner negativity under Gaussian operations.
method: Steered negativity as a multiplicative monotone.

title: Finding diagonal logical gates in CSS codes and circuits
problem: Algorithms that find all diagonal logical gates of CSS codes and spacetime circuits.
method: Efficient enumeration of diagonal logical gates.

title: Approximate synthesis of general single-qubit unitaries over the Clifford+sqrt(T) gate set
problem: Ancilla-free approximate synthesis over Clifford+sqrt(T), extending the minimal-T-count Clifford+T result.

title: Improved lower bounds for the kissing number in dimensions 49 to 61
problem: Improved kissing lower bounds in dimensions 49 to 61, reaching 92 to 100 percent of the trivial bound 7193t.
method: Maximum-coverage greedy search with iterated local search over pools of 4000 automorphic images, verified in exact integer arithmetic.
checked: partial (all results verified in exact integer arithmetic, per abstract)

title: Milne's rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization
problem: Proves Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties over the algebraic closure of Q with good reduction, including residue characteristic 2.
method: Uses the Hodge theorem for CM abelian varieties to represent each specialized Hodge class by one rational algebraic cycle in every prime-to-p and crystalline realization.

title: The full BSD formula from low Selmer corank
problem: Proves the full Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for elliptic curves over Q whose q-power Selmer group has corank zero or one, with Sha finite.

title: The quasi-Riemann hypothesis
problem: Proves that Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, have no zeros in Re s > 7/8, and the same holds for finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)).

title: Hilbert's tenth problem over Q
problem: Proves that no algorithm decides whether an integer polynomial in any number of variables has a rational zero.

title: Irrationality of Catalan's constant
problem: Proves that Catalan's constant G = sum of (-1)^j/(2j+1)^2 is irrational.

title: Goldfeld's conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank
problem: Proves that for quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over Q, analytic ranks 0 and 1 each have density 1/2 and the mean analytic rank tends to 1/2.

title: Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected Elliott conjecture
problem: Proves the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture with a power-of-log saving, and the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for bounded multiplicative functions under uniform nonpretentiousness.

title: The Deligne-Drinfeld conjecture
problem: Proves that the rational Grothendieck-Teichmuller Lie algebra is freely generated by one element in each odd weight at least three.

title: Function-field reconstruction from Milnor K-theory and Galois data
problem: Reconstructs function fields of transcendence degree at least two over algebraically closed fields from mod-l Milnor K-groups and their product, and proves Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction from pro-l Galois data.
method: Recovers the perfect closure and constant field from the mod-l groups K1/l and K2/l and their bilinear product, a reconstruction of the Bogomolov-Pop type.

title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
problem: Proves that every odd absolutely irreducible 2-adic representation of G_Q unramified outside finitely many primes occurs in a completed Hecke algebra, and proves modularity up to Tate twist in the de Rham case with distinct Hodge-Tate weights.

title: Prime-factor statistics of p-1
problem: Proves that normalized log-sizes of the prime factors of p-1 converge jointly to the Poisson-Dirichlet law PD(1), and that infinitely many n have more than n^(1-eps) totient preimages.

title: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers
problem: Proves that log P+(n)/log n and log P+(n+1)/log n are asymptotically independent with Dickman marginals, so P+(n) < P+(n+1) has density 1/2.

title: Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture
problem: Proves that no finite modification of the primes can be written as A+B with A and B nonnegative integer sets, each with at least two elements.

title: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan
field: geometric Langlands, automorphic forms over function fields
problem: Proves the restricted geometric Langlands equivalence under four Lie-theoretic hypotheses, Ramanujan at all places for globally generic exceptional groups, and Arthur enhancements of cuspidal parameters given a finite-level Ramanujan-Arthur decomposition.

title: Torus-packet equidistribution in prime, quartic, and sextic degrees
problem: Proves Haar equidistribution without escape of mass for complete volume-weighted torus packets from totally real fields of prime degree at least five, primitive quartic fields, and primitive sextic fields.
method: For quartic orders, combines measure rigidity with a cubic-resolvent estimate that stays uniform at primes dividing the order index (quartic manuscript abstract).

title: Zilber-Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold
problem: Proves the abelian Zilber-Pink conjecture over the algebraic closure of Q and the curve case of Zilber-Pink in the Siegel threefold A_2 for Hodge-generic curves.

title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
problem: Proves that the irrationality exponent of pi is exactly 2, and as a consequence that the Flint-Hills series converges.

title: The Margulis-Platonov conjecture over global fields
problem: Proves that every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of G(k) is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of a finite product of anisotropic local groups, over every global field including characteristic two.

title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
problem: Proves that rational points on smooth proper curves of genus at least two over finite extensions of Q_p correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of the arithmetic etale fundamental group, and the global section conjecture for X_0(N) and X_1(N).
method: Constructs one connected finite etale cover with a sheet isomorphic to the exterior of finitely many small disks, with degree divisible by p on each component above each disk (sub-paper abstract).

title: Squarefree quartics and power-free polynomial values
problem: Proves that irreducible integer quartics with no fixed prime-square divisor take squarefree values with the predicted density, and extends power-free density to degrees 4 through 8.
method: Combines number-field factorization, determinant estimates with adaptive auxiliary primes, and explicit low-degree geometry, with Browning's theorem for higher degrees (manuscript abstract).

title: A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal's function
problem: Proves that every interval of Ck^2 consecutive integers contains an integer coprime to any n with at most k prime divisors, answering Jacobsthal's quadratic-bound question.
method: Expands discarded integers into trees of decreasing primes with linear-sieve reference terms, then bounds the discrepancy from actual residue-class counts by an inverse estimate that forces rational alignment of the forbidden classes (Jarnik lattice-point and larger-sieve pair counts), with stopping rules at even nodes.
location: Introduction (pp. 2-3) and Outline of the argument (pp. 4-5); detailed in Sections 3, 8 and 10

title: The weak inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer conjecture
problem: Proves that for every real shift gamma and finite-valued psi, divergence of the sum of phi(q)psi(q)/q implies ||qx-gamma|| < psi(q) for infinitely many q, for almost every x.

title: Patterson's first moment for cubic Gauss sums
problem: Proves unconditionally the all-primary-prime first-moment asymptotic for normalized cubic Gauss sums over Eisenstein primes, with main term of order X^(5/6)/log X.

title: An asymptotic formula for the number of totients
problem: Gives an asymptotic equivalent for the number of distinct totient values up to x, and proves that V(cx)/V(x) tends to c for every fixed c > 0.

title: Short Egyptian fractions
problem: Proves that every rational a/b with 1 <= a < b is a sum of O(log log b) distinct unit fractions, resolving an Erdos conjecture.

title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
problem: Proves that for every fixed C > 0, a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed C log p_n in every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes.

title: Potential integral density on curve character varieties
problem: Proves that integral points are potentially Zariski dense in every component of the SL_r character variety of a smooth complex curve, allowing prescribed quasi-unipotent boundary classes.

title: Uniformly bounded components of Gaussian-prime graphs
problem: Proves that for each distance bound D, the graph joining Gaussian primes at distance at most D has uniformly bounded finite component sizes, which settles the Gaussian moat conjecture.
method: Builds a finite periodic sieve obstruction using geometric sampling and information-theoretic estimates (abstract only).

title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base
problem: Proves the infinitude assertion in Artin's primitive root conjecture for every integer a that is neither -1 nor a square, with at least c_a x/(log x)^2 such primes in (x, 2x).

title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
problem: Proves that every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.

title: Uchida's conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups
problem: Proves that every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields comes from a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction.

title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
problem: Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for complex CM abelian varieties in every dimension and codimension, which also yields the Tate conjecture over finite fields via Milne's theorems.

title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity
problem: Proves Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity for smooth Fujiki-class-C manifolds with rational snc boundaries, and Popa's Iitaka inequality for projective fibrations with whole-fiber variation.

title: Log abundance for compact Kahler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
problem: Proves log abundance for normal compact Kahler log canonical pairs with effective rational boundary, and projective log abundance over fields of characteristic zero, using logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity as the input.
method: Reduces log abundance to logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity, which the abstract states as its assumption (abstract only).

title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one
problem: Proves log abundance for projective log canonical threefolds over fields of characteristic p > 3 when the adjoint divisor is nef of numerical dimension one.

title: Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models
problem: Proves numerical semiampleness of nef adjoints K_X+B+M, and existence of minimal models for generalized log canonical pairs.
method: Uses Bott-Chern cohomology to represent the real first Chern class of the nef adjoint by a semiample rational line bundle in the compact Kahler case (abstract only).

title: The ordinary-double-point volume gap
problem: Proves that every singular boundary-zero klt germ of dimension n >= 2 has normalized volume at most 2(n-1)^n, with equality exactly at an analytic ordinary double point.

title: Fujita's freeness conjecture
problem: Proves that K_X + mL is globally generated for every ample L and every m >= n+1 on a smooth complex projective variety of dimension n.

title: Nagata's conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants
problem: Proves Nagata's strict inequality for plane curves of degree d through r >= 10 very general points, and maximal multipoint Seshadri constants for smooth polarized varieties at large r.

title: Bloch's conjecture for complex surfaces
problem: Proves that for smooth connected projective complex surfaces with p_g = 0, the Albanese map on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism.

title: Hyperkahler SYZ and projective-space bases
problem: Proves that holomorphic line bundles with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifolds are semiample, and that projective Lagrangian fibrations have projective space as base.

title: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII
problem: Proves that every complex K3 surface is Oka, and that every minimal surface of Kodaira dimension zero is Oka, with class VII Oka exactly for Hopf and Enoki surfaces.

title: P = W for fixed-determinant SL_n moduli spaces
problem: Proves P_k = W_2k = W_2k+1 on the rational cohomology of fixed-determinant, trace-free Higgs moduli spaces in composite rank over curves of genus at least two.

title: The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture
problem: Proves the equivariant cohomological Hikita correspondence for arbitrary finite quivers, identifying the equivariant cohomology of the Nakajima variety with the coordinate ring of a cocharacter-fixed locus of the Coulomb branch.

title: Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group
problem: Constructs a smooth projective complex fourfold with large fundamental group whose universal cover is not Stein, and a smooth projective surface whose universal cover is not holomorphically convex.

title: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers
problem: Constructs an integral complex affine fourfold X, not isomorphic to A^4, with X x A^1 isomorphic to A^5, disproving affine-space cancellation over C in dimension four.

title: A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman-Zariski
problem: Constructs a singular normal affine complex surface with free rank-two tangent sheaf, disproving the characteristic-zero Lipman-Zariski conjecture.

title: A stable-coordinate counterexample in four variables
problem: A degree-five polynomial over C in four variables is not a coordinate but becomes one after adjoining a variable, disproving the stable coordinate conjecture and the Abhyankar–Sathaye embedding conjecture in dimension four.
method: Explicit degree-five polynomial whose zero fibre is affine three-space while its embedding is not rectifiable; the argument that it is not a coordinate is unclear from abstract.

title: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture
problem: Ample rank-two bundles on P^1 x P^1 admit no smooth Hermitian metric with strictly Griffiths-positive curvature.
method: Explicit bundle G whose coordinatewise power pullbacks twisted by O(1,1) are ample for every power, while no strictly Griffiths-positive metric exists for large powers.

title: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture
problem: Every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is projective.

title: Tangent splittings and product decompositions
problem: A splitting of the tangent bundle of a compact Kähler manifold into two integrable holomorphic subbundles gives a compatible product decomposition of the universal cover.

title: A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow
field: tautological rings of moduli of stable curves
problem: A tautological relation on a moduli space of stable pointed curves vanishes in rational Chow and rational cohomology but lies outside Pixton's relation span.
method: Explicit construction of a formal tautological class of genus 10^60 with 3 binomial(10^60, 3) markings that lies outside the original relation span yet has zero image in Chow; construction details unclear from abstract.

title: Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations
problem: Very general cubic fourfolds of sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant are irrational despite having geometric K3 categories, disproving Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture.
method: unclear from abstract; the abstract says the discriminant threshold is ineffective.

title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds
problem: Proves Toda's normalized Gepner conjecture on every smooth quintic threefold and constructs numerical Bridgeland stability conditions at large volume on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle.
method: Construction of numerical Bridgeland stability conditions with prescribed ordinary and square-root-Todd central charges at large volume, with the spherical twist at the structure sheaf as the phase-shift operator; construction details unclear from abstract.

title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs
problem: Every generalized log canonical flip sequence on a globally Weil Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold terminates, and every permitted MMP for a projective lc fourfold with rational boundary terminates.

title: Fundamental groups of special complex varieties and root orbifolds
problem: Proves Campana's abelianity conjecture for special compact Kähler manifolds, extends virtual abelianity to order-two root orbifolds, and bounds nilpotency class for linear representations of special quasi-projective varieties.
method: Reduction of the root-orbifold and quasi-projective cases to the compact Kähler abelianity theorem, as stated in the abstract; the internal argument is unclear from abstract.

title: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains
problem: Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective complex varieties are exactly products D x C^m x F, with D bounded symmetric and F simply connected, normal and projective.

title: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture
problem: Reduced hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic can have different multiplicities, including germs in C^4 with isolated critical points and multiplicities four and five.
method: Explicit construction of ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurface germs; the argument for the homeomorphism is unclear from abstract.

title: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture
problem: Every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with b_2 > 0 contains a global spherical shell.

title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture
problem: Positive quaternionic-Kähler manifolds of dimension at least eight are homothetic to Wolf spaces, and smooth projective contact manifolds of dimension at least three are classified by their second Betti number.

title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
problem: For a smooth complex projective Fano manifold, rho(iota - 1) is at most n, with equality only for a product of rho projective spaces of dimension iota - 1.

title: Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities
problem: Every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in C^3 with constant Milnor number is topologically right-trivial.

title: Virasoro constraints for complete intersections and projective-bundle towers
problem: Full ordinary descendant Virasoro constraints hold for smooth complete intersections in projective space, and pass to projectivizations of every algebraic vector bundle of rank at least two.
method: Reduction of the Virasoro constraints from a smooth projective base to the projectivization of any vector bundle, with no splitting or positivity hypothesis; the mechanism is unclear from abstract.

title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
problem: Every epsilon-lc Fano contraction over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero admits klt complements of index bounded by the dimension and epsilon, which gives the finite-coefficient form of Shokurov's conjecture.

title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
problem: Every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.

title: Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension
problem: If -K_X has a smooth semipositive metric on a smooth connected projective complex variety X, then some positive multiple of -K_X has a nonzero section.
method: Torus-invariant Euler characteristic argument, removal of a fixed pseudoeffective error from an unbounded sequence of effective twists, and metric descent to a corrected line bundle, as named in the companion abstracts.

title: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level
problem: The unramified de Rham quantum geometric Langlands equivalence holds for every connected simple group at every non-rational shifted level, retaining all global forms and components.

title: Koebe's circle-domain conjecture
problem: Every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a circle domain, and circle domains with conformally removable boundary are rigid.

title: Brennan's conjecture and the integral-means spectrum
problem: Brennan's conjecture holds for 4/3 < s < 4, the sharp universal integral-means identity holds for t <= -2, and the bounded spectrum satisfies B_b(-1) < 1/4.
method: Sharp integral-means estimate for inverse-first-power means of normalized univalent disk maps, giving a uniform bound with exponent below 1/4; the mechanism is unclear from abstract.

title: The Falconer distance conjecture
problem: Every compact subset of R^d (d >= 2) with Hausdorff dimension greater than d/2 determines a set of Euclidean distances of positive Lebesgue measure.

title: Kakeya in three and four dimensions
problem: In R^3 the radius-delta tube maximal operator maps L^3 to L^3(S^2) with norm O(delta^(-epsilon)), and every four-dimensional Kakeya set has full Hausdorff dimension.

title: The L log L Fourier-convergence conjecture
problem: Ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued L log L function on the circle converge almost everywhere along the full sequence.

title: Real ultraflat Littlewood polynomials and unbounded binary merit factors
problem: For every sufficiently large length N there are polynomials with coefficients in {-1, 1} whose modulus is (1+o(1)) sqrt(N) on the unit circle, so binary merit factors are unbounded.
method: Construction, at each large length, of ±1 polynomials with uniformly flat modulus; details unclear from abstract.

title: Fourier restriction for positively curved surfaces
problem: The diagonal Fourier extension operator maps L^p(Sigma) to L^p(R^3) for p > 3 on every compact positively curved surface in R^3, including surfaces with boundary.
method: Elliptic capacity propagation, named in a companion manuscript title; the mechanism is unclear from abstract.

title: The three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture
problem: Bochner–Riesz multipliers of order delta are bounded on L^p(R^3) for every delta > max{3|1/p - 1/2| - 1/2, 0}.
method: Boundedness on L^3 for every positive order, followed by interpolation and duality to cover the full strict range.

title: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation
problem: Sogge's local smoothing conjecture holds in every spatial dimension at least two, with arbitrarily small loss above the sharp Sobolev threshold.
method: Sharp local smoothing estimate for the wave equation, from which Bochner–Riesz, maximal and square function bounds are deduced; the internal argument is unclear from abstract.

title: The exact Sobolev endpoint for Schrödinger convergence
problem: Almost-everywhere convergence of e^{itΔ}f to f as t goes to 0 for every f in H^{n/(2(n+1))}(R^n) with n >= 2, including the planar endpoint H^{1/3}.
method: Evolution defined by removing Gaussian regularization on a full-measure spatial set, which makes the evolution continuous at t = 0; the core estimate is unclear from abstract.

title: Riesz transforms and rectifiability in higher codimension
problem: For d >= 4 and 2 <= n <= d-2, uniform L^2 boundedness of the n-dimensional Riesz transform implies uniform n-rectifiability of an n-Ahlfors–David regular Radon measure.

title: Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform
problem: Annular r-variation bounds (r > 2) and a maximal bound for the triangular Hilbert transform from L^3 x L^3 to L^(3/2), together with an L^3 bound for the dyadic triangular Hilbert form.
method: Annular r-variation estimate with partitions depending on the output point and ranging over all scales, which yields the two-endpoint maximal bound; the dyadic form is bounded by summing absolute local contributions over scales.

title: Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions
problem: Uniform L^2 bound for the planar Hilbert transform along a Lipschitz unit vector field, with integration length bounded by a fixed multiple of the reciprocal Lipschitz constant.

title: The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
problem: For every fixed q in (0,1) there are compact subsets of [0,1] of measure close to one with no affine copy of {q^n : n >= 1}; a companion manuscript treats the dyadic sequence.
method: Construction of large-measure compact sets avoiding affine copies of geometric progressions; construction details unclear from abstract.

title: Endpoint Sobolev regularity of centered disk averages
problem: For real f in W^{1,1}(R^2), the centered disk maximal function satisfies the endpoint gradient bound ||grad Mf||_1 <= C ||grad f||_1 with an absolute constant C.

title: An L^3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform
problem: The principal-value trilinear Hilbert transform with shifts x-t, x-2t, x-3t is bounded from L^3 x L^3 x L^3 to L^1.

title: The Mahler conjectures, functional inequalities and polar-product symplectic width
problem: Symmetric and general geometric Mahler conjectures hold in every dimension, with Hanner polytopes and simplices as the minimizers, and every symmetric polar product has Gromov width 4.
method: Smooth symplectic embeddings of balls of every capacity below 4 into the polar product K x K°, combined with volume preservation, to resolve the symmetric Mahler conjecture (companion manuscript).

title: Sharp projection-body inequalities and a counterexample to simplex maximization
problem: Petty's projection-volume conjecture holds in dimensions at least four, and products of simplices exceed Brannen's proposed simplex maximum for projection-body volume by an exponential factor in large dimensions.
method: Counterexample from a product of two ten-dimensional simplices, which has larger normalized projection-body volume than a twenty-dimensional simplex; the Petty argument is unclear from abstract.

title: Bounded-distortion L1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs
problem: Shortest-path metrics of finite planar graphs and of bounded-treewidth graphs embed into L1 with bounded distortion, so the corresponding multicommodity flow-cut gaps are bounded.

title: Triangular-lattice optimality, long-range Riesz and Coulomb energies, and spherical logarithmic energy
problem: The triangular lattice minimizes the lower energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone potential of squared distance, and it minimizes planar Riesz, Coulomb and logarithmic renormalized energies.
method: Atomic interpolation certificate that yields sharp Gaussian Fourier minorants, combined with positive mixtures and heat-kernel comparison; the planar circle-packing companion proves the Cohn–Elkies two-point Fourier bound is sharp using a radial Schwartz certificate checked with interval arithmetic.

title: Logarithmic and Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequalities and the B-conjecture
problem: The logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski inequality holds for origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension, giving the B-conjecture for even log-concave measures and the additive Lp inequality for 0 < p < 1.

title: The optimal order of convex-body covering density
problem: The optimal worst-case covering density of convex bodies is Theta(n log n), for both lattice and unrestricted translative coverings.

title: Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures
problem: Centered log-concave measures with uniformly subgaussian linear marginals satisfy a logarithmic Sobolev inequality whose constant is a universal multiple of the squared linear subgaussian parameter.

title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp
problem: Every n-point subset of real Lp (1 < p < infinity) embeds into l_p^d with distortion D and dimension d = n^(o(1)), while exact embeddings need dimension Theta(n^2) when p is not 2.

title: Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts
problem: Some hyperbolicity cones admit no finite affine semidefinite lift, which disproves the Projected Lax conjecture and the generalized Lax conjecture.
method: Explicit homogeneous polynomial of degree 16 in 23 real variables whose hyperbolicity cone has no finite symmetric linear matrix inequality representation; a companion paper gives an exact lift of size 100 with 307 auxiliary variables for the same cone.

title: The Gaussian propeller conjecture in every dimension
problem: The sum of squared Gaussian first moments of any finite measurable partition is at most 9/(8 pi), and with the Unique Games theorem this gives NP-hardness of improving the kernel clustering loss factor for fixed k >= 3.
method: Sharp upper bound over all finite measurable partitions, with equality for three planar sectors of angle 2 pi/3 extended orthogonally; the argument is unclear from abstract.

title: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound
problem: Every finite sequence in the Euclidean unit ball of R^d admits signs keeping every partial sum within C sqrt(d), so the Euclidean Steinitz constant is Theta(sqrt d).
method: Choice of signs that keeps every signed prefix bounded independently of the sequence length; the selection mechanism is unclear from abstract.

title: Compact counterexamples to bi-Lipschitz dimension reduction
problem: Every infinite-dimensional real Banach space has a compact doubling subset with no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional normed space, answering the Lang-Plaut problem negatively.

title: The sharp exponential scale of edit-distance distortion
problem: The least l1 distortion for embedding unit-cost edit distance on words of length at most d is exp(Theta(sqrt(log d log log d))), uniformly over alphabets.
method: Lower bound from binary words via finite-circle obstructions and binary coding arguments; upper bound from a finite histogram embedding that develops the Ostrovsky-Rabani overlapping-substring method.

title: Cylinder coverings below the half-area bound
problem: A finite cover of the closed regular tetrahedron by cylinders with triangular perpendicular bases can have total base area below half the minimum projection area, disproving Bang's half-area bound.
method: Explicit finite cylinder covering with triangular bases, with total base area chosen under half the minimum projection; the construction details are unclear from abstract.

title: The sharp simplex conjecture for isotropic constants
problem: Simplices uniquely maximize the isotropic constant among convex bodies in every dimension, and log-concave densities satisfy a sharp entropy lower bound with equality for affine images of products of one-sided exponentials.

title: The Unique Games Conjecture and optimal approximation thresholds
problem: Unique Games is NP-hard in the sense of the conjecture, and Max-Cut, Vertex Cover, Min-UnCut and directed feedback vertex set have optimal hardness thresholds on unweighted graphs.
method: Direct reductions from established PCP and Label Cover hardness results; the proof of the Unique Games reduction itself is unclear from abstract.

title: Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: L = RL = BPL
problem: Every randomized polynomial-time logarithmic-space machine with one-sided or two-sided error can be converted into a deterministic log-space decider with explicit polynomial time bounds.
method: An effective compiler from randomized log-space machines to deterministic log-space deciders; internal construction unclear from abstract.

title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games
field: algorithmic game theory, games on graphs
problem: Mean-payoff games, turn-based stochastic mean-payoff games and mean-payoff parity games with binary weights are solved exactly in 2^(O((log(L+2))^2)) bit operations.
method: Deterministic algorithm with exact rational arithmetic that outputs values and optimal positional strategies; the technique is unclear from abstract.

title: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games
problem: For every fixed rational delta in (0,1), it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable 2-to-1 games from games of value at most delta, on unweighted instances with a fixed alphabet.
method: Gap reduction to 2-to-1 games in which every right-hand label has exactly two preimages under each constraint map; the construction is unclear from abstract.

title: Hardness of coloring three-colorable graphs
problem: It is NP-hard to properly color a three-colorable graph with any fixed number c >= 3 of colors, because finding large independent sets in three-colorable graphs is hard.
method: Deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3SAT to simple graphs that are three-colorable when the formula is satisfiable and have no independent set of size delta n otherwise.

title: Matrix multiplication with exponent at most 9/4
problem: The complex matrix multiplication exponent omega is at most 9/4, with rectangular and field-dependent refinements such as omega below 2.258 over characteristic zero.

title: A cubic permanent-determinant lower bound
problem: The border determinantal complexity of the m by m permanent is Omega(m^3), and the same cubic bound holds for exact representations and affine-linear branching programs.

title: Integer multiplication below n log n
problem: Two n-bit integers can be multiplied exactly in O(n (log n)^(1-kappa)) time on a fixed multitape Turing machine, disproving the Schonhage-Strassen optimality conjecture in that model.

title: Optimal-order randomized k-server on arbitrary metrics
problem: Randomized k-server has competitive ratio O(log^2(k+1)) on every metric, matching the worst-case lower bound order.
method: One policy serves every finite oblivious request sequence, with a uniform implementation on finite rational metrics; the technique is unclear from abstract.

title: One-sample matroid prophet inequalities against an almighty adversary
problem: For every finite matroid, an online rule using one independent sample per element earns a universal constant fraction of the expected offline optimum, even against an adversary that sees the samples and the random seed.
method: Distribution-free online rule built from one sample per element, with a constant competitive ratio that holds against an adversary that sees the full random seed; the rule's construction is unclear from abstract.

title: Beyond the square-root exponent for depth-three circuits
problem: An explicit language in deterministic polynomial time needs 2^(omega(sqrt n)) gates in unbounded fan-in OR-AND-OR circuits.

title: Approximate counting and entropy of perfect matchings
problem: There is a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting perfect matchings in general graphs, and the maximum entropy of a matching law with edge marginals x is sandwiched between F(x) - (2-2/m) B(x) and F(x).
method: Entropy sandwich on the perfect-matching polytope, with F(x) the sum of -x_e log x_e and B(x) the sum of -(1-x_e) log(1-x_e); the FPRAS technique is unclear from abstract.

title: Approximate counting of common integer polymatroid bases
problem: Common integer bases of two polymatroids of equal total rank can be counted with a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme, given exact rank-value oracles.
method: Counts common bases directly with binary capacities, without expanding them into labelled copies; the sampling chain is unclear from abstract.

title: Sampling and counting contingency tables with arbitrary margins
problem: Exact uniform sampling and an FPRAS for nonnegative integer tables with prescribed row and column sums, with or without cell bounds.

title: Uniform black-box noncommutative identity testing across characteristics
problem: A single deterministic polynomial-time matrix tuple detects every nonzero division-free noncommutative formula of bounded size over any field of a given characteristic.
method: One matrix substitution (a hitting point) that detects every nonzero formula, with dimension O(n^3 s^6) in positive characteristic and O(n s^2) over characteristic zero.

title: Uniform sparsest cut: hardness and semidefinite gaps
problem: Goemans-Linial semidefinite relaxation has integrality gaps of order sqrt(log n)/(log log n)^3 for uniform sparsest cut, and approximating uniform sparsest cut within any constant is NP-hard.
method: Near-square-root paper: a parameter-cube family of charts with rounded coordinates gives a negative-type semimetric whose average distance survives every l1 contraction, and cut-cone duality then yields capacities with unit demand on all pairs of copies.
location: Near-square-root integrality gap paper, Sections 1.2 (proof strategy) and 6; the hardness paper is abstract only.

title: Bin packing and unbounded configuration-LP gaps
problem: The integral bin-packing optimum can exceed the configuration LP value by an arbitrarily large additive constant, and approximating it within any fixed additive constant is NP-hard.
method: Explicit instances with arbitrarily large configuration-LP gaps; the construction is unclear from abstract.

title: The Courtade-Kumar and Hellinger conjectures
problem: Among Boolean functions of independent uniform bits, a single coordinate keeps the most mutual information after independent bit-flip noise, and the Hellinger contraction bound holds for every Boolean output bias.
method: Explicit three-point optimizer for a local joining problem, two entropy capacities and a common-output thinning inequality, combined with dimension induction and integration along the noise semigroup; the Hellinger paper adds asymmetric induction and finite exact-arithmetic certificates.

title: Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs
problem: A randomized algorithm finds a maximum-cardinality matching in any simple graph in (n+m)^(1+o(1)) word time with success probability at least 2/3.

title: Almost-linear approximation of edit distance
problem: For every fixed rational epsilon in (0,1), unit-cost edit distance can be approximated within factor 1+epsilon in expected time N^(1+o(1)).

title: Quantitative trace-reconstruction bounds with a uniform decoder
problem: Reconstructing a binary string from deletion traces needs n^(Omega(log log n)) traces for every fixed deletion probability, and a uniform decoder works with quasipolynomial samples.
method: Latest-anchor induction with spectrally compact masks (third manuscript); the decoder's construction is unclear from abstract.

title: Polynomial-time scheduling on three identical machines
problem: Unit-length jobs with arbitrary precedence constraints on three identical machines can be scheduled to minimum makespan in deterministic polynomial time.
method: Dynamic program over a polynomial family of bounded-size interval descriptions of schedules, with global boundary conditions keeping the descriptions bounded.

title: The metric k-median approximation threshold and recovery
problem: Metric k-median has a deterministic polynomial-time (1+2/e+epsilon)-approximation, and under P not equal to NP the threshold 1+2/e is optimal.
method: Exact-budget recovery from proxy costs in an anchor solution, plus a bounded-price argument for a logarithmic-surplus construction.

title: Exponential semidefinite complexity of perfect matching
problem: Every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size, answering Rothvoss's question negatively.
method: Lower bound on the real PSD rank of the odd-cut slack matrix after a fixed positive shift rho, which yields 2^(Omega(n)) for matching-matrix factorizations.

title: Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions
problem: A degree-at-most-d polynomial threshold function on the uniform n-cube has average sensitivity at most 8d sqrt(n), proving the asymptotic Gotsman-Linial conjecture.

title: A factor-two approximation for shortest common superstring
problem: A deterministic polynomial-time algorithm outputs a common superstring at most twice the optimum length for every finite family of strings.
method: Deterministic 2-approximation that differs from the classical maximum-overlap Greedy procedure; the construction is unclear from abstract.

title: Exponential state costs for two-way automata
problem: Complementing two-way nondeterministic automata, and simulating one-way nondeterministic automata by two-way deterministic ones, both need exponentially many states, resolving the Sakoda-Sipser conjecture.
method: Explicit automaton families with exponential state lower bounds for complementation and for two-way deterministic simulation; the construction is unclear from abstract.

title: Exact Fourier transforms below n log n
problem: An exact length-n DFT uses O(n (log n)^(1-delta)) operations for every n, with delta = 10^-13.
method: Finite tensor saving: a tensor power of a fixed invertible nonmonomial matrix needs fewer matrix calls than the standard tensor-axis algorithm when invertible monomial maps are allowed between calls.

title: Rapid mixing of graph switches for every degree sequence
problem: The lazy edge-switch chain on simple graphs mixes in O(n^8) time for every graphical degree sequence, and degree-constrained graphs can be sampled exactly.
method: Lazy switch chain that proposes switches uniformly on four vertices, giving a polynomial total-variation mixing bound; the mixing argument itself is unclear from abstract.

title: A superquadratic separation between sensitivity and block sensitivity
problem: Total Boolean functions exist with block sensitivity at least s(f)^alpha for some fixed alpha > 2, disproving the quadratic strengthening of the Sensitivity Conjecture.

title: The computational complexity of Weisfeiler-Leman refinement
problem: Joint and separate k-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman equivalence need n^(Omega(k)) deterministic time, and deciding whether refinement identifies a graph is EXPTIME-complete.
method: Reduction from a finite-domain choice system to pairs of uncolored graphs that are k-WL equivalent exactly when the system has no compatible choice; parity lifts and bounded-treewidth witnesses are named in the sibling manuscript.

title: Generalized star height at most three
problem: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has a generalized regular expression of bounded star height, with the headline claiming three and sibling manuscripts claiming thirteen and four.
method: Finite monoid computations are written as affine updates and recovered through successive split constructions; the three-height manuscript instead uses a prefix code of word pieces.

title: Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
problem: Over characteristic-zero fields, the (1,1) entry of a product of n independent n by n variable matrices needs n^(Theta(sqrt n)) gates in homogeneous depth-five circuits.
method: Block expansion gives the matching upper bound; the lower-bound technique is unclear from abstract.

title: A quasilinear PCP theorem for PPAD
problem: An End-of-Line instance of length N reduces to numerical circuit constraints of length N (log N)^O(1), so that a robust approximate assignment yields an endpoint solution.

title: One-tape time simulation in two-fifths-power space
problem: A fixed deterministic one-tape machine's halting outcome up to time T can be computed in O(T^(2/5) polylog T) space, improving the square-root exponent.
method: Space-efficient simulation with a polylogarithmic accessor for initial tape and input symbols within distance T of the head origin; the simulator's internals are unclear from abstract.

title: Subset Sum in O(2^(0.49n)) time
problem: Worst-case Subset Sum has a uniform randomized algorithm running in O(2^(0.49n)) word-RAM time, and a sibling manuscript gives poly(n) 2^(n/2) time with O(2^(n/5)) words.

title: Subpolynomial query complexity for well-conditioned log-concave sampling
problem: Sampling within total variation 1/10 needs only C_epsilon d^epsilon exact value-and-gradient queries, and an Omega(log d) lower bound holds for adaptive algorithms.
method: Recursively nested noisy conditional means of a Gaussian-smoothed potential, evaluated with finitely many gradient queries (Section 1.3); the lower bound reduces adaptive algorithms to block-Krylov information via Gaussian rotational invariance (Section 1.3).
location: Subpolynomial query complexity paper, Sections 1.2 and 1.3 (proof strategy and principal ingredients).

title: Memory-sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression
problem: A one-pass learner with A d^2 persistent bits needs Omega_A(d log(1/epsilon)) noiseless Gaussian samples to recover a unit vector to angular error epsilon.
method: Information bound on finite messages built from exact Gaussian measurements, using random projection moments and conditioning on each batch's projection; the subsphere residual argument is named in the sibling manuscript.

title: Existential-universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy
problem: The existential theory of the reals lies in the counting hierarchy, and existential-universal real sentences are decidable at one fixed level of that hierarchy.

title: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields
problem: A uniform deterministic algorithm completely factors every nonzero dense degree-n polynomial over F_p with bit complexity polynomial in (n+1) log p.
method: Deterministic factorization that relies on a uniform Hecke zero-free theorem from the companion paper Primitive roots for every admissible integer base.

title: Hilbert's sixteenth problem: uniform bounds for limit cycles
problem: The number of isolated periodic orbits of a real planar polynomial vector field is bounded by a constant depending only on its degree, and quintic Lienard systems have exactly two limit cycles.
method: Separation of asymptotic expansions on nested complex domains, followed by a finite-dimensional counting argument.

title: Banach's simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem
problem: A smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of the three-torus has simple Lebesgue spectrum on its whole mean-zero L2 space.

title: Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem
problem: Every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of every finite order.

title: Positive metric entropy for the standard map
problem: The standard sine map on the 2-torus has positive metric entropy for every sufficiently large parameter, answering Sinai's positive-parameter-measure conjecture.

title: The near-boundary Birkhoff conjecture
problem: A smooth strictly convex planar billiard of positive curvature is an ellipse when a full grazing annulus is continuously foliated by invariant closed convex caustics.
method: A continuous foliation of the grazing annulus forces an analytic boundary and a jointly analytic collar of caustics, and a rigidity theorem then removes any differentiability assumption across the leaves.

title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures
problem: The Hausdorff dimension of every finite self-similar measure on the line equals the minimum of one and the random-walk entropy rate divided by the Lyapunov exponent, with exact overlaps allowed.

title: Classwise permanence for weakly reversible mass-action systems
problem: Every positive trajectory of a finite weakly reversible mass-action system eventually stays between fixed positive lower and finite upper concentration bounds on its stoichiometric class.
method: Each positive stoichiometric class has one compact convex forward-invariant set that every positive trajectory in the class enters in finite time.

title: Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
problem: The billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with an angle irrational relative to pi is weakly mixing.

title: A C^1 counterexample to the entropy conjecture
problem: A noninvertible C^1 self-map of a compact smooth manifold has zero topological entropy while its action on second homology has eigenvalue 2.
method: unclear from abstract (the abstract states an explicit construction of the self-map)

title: Zero entropy does not guarantee a smooth positive-volume model
problem: A zero-entropy ergodic invertible transformation is not measurably conjugate to any smooth diffeomorphism with a strictly positive smooth invariant density, in any finite dimension.

title: Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions
problem: Unbiased Bernoulli convolutions are classified as singular or absolutely continuous by a one-sided approximation condition on finite sets of algebraic units, and they are singular at reciprocals of quartic Salem numbers.

title: Pointwise multiple ergodic averages for mixing transformations
problem: Consecutive multiple ergodic averages of every finite length converge almost everywhere to the product of the integrals for every invertible mixing transformation.

title: A counterexample to periodic tiling in dimension three
problem: A finite translational tile in Z^3 admits tilings but no fully periodic tiling, which disproves the periodic tiling conjecture in dimension three.

title: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine
problem: A compact subset of R^9 cannot be covered by ten sets of strictly smaller diameter, using rank-one projectors onto lines in R^4 with the Frobenius metric.
method: unclear from abstract (the example itself is explicit)

title: Graph coloring, clique minors, and Colin de Verdiere invariants
problem: Arbitrarily large graphs with independence number at most two have fractional chromatic number above their Hadwiger number, which disproves Hadwiger's conjecture and its fractional form.
method: Sample a hole relation with no loops or triangles from a finite probability space, use an entropy-minimizing container argument with a capacitated cut to force conflicting unit pairs, and certify each hole with a shared tensor whose cross-contraction identities cancel around a hypothetical triangle.
